name: remove_review
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Remove one of your own Yelp reviews. Only the current user's reviews can be deleted.

name: get_business
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Get the full details of a business.

business_id.description: The unique identifier of the business.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Business object including business_id, name, category, address, rating, review_count, price_level, opening_hours, phone, website.

name: get_my_yelp_reviews
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Get all Yelp reviews written by the current user.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: The current user's reviews, newest first.

name: get_yelp_profile
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Get the current user's Yelp profile.

name: get_review_details
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Get the full details of a specific review by ID.

review_id.description: The unique identifier of the review.

name: get_reviews_for_business
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Get reviews for a specific business.

business_id.description: The business to get reviews for.

max_results.description: Maximum reviews to return. Defaults to 20.

sort_by.description: Sort order. One of "newest", "oldest", "highest", "lowest", "most_helpful". Defaults to "newest".

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Review objects sorted as requested.

name: list_saved_businesses
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: List all saved/bookmarked businesses.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Saved place objects with business_id and name.

name: mark_review_useful
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Mark a review as useful. You cannot mark your own review.

review_id.description: The review to mark as useful.

name: save_business
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Save (bookmark) a business for later reference.

name: search_businesses
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Search for businesses by name, location, category, or other criteria.

query.description: Text to match against business name.

location.description: Text to match against business address.

sort_by.description: Sort order. One of "rating", "review_count", "name". Defaults to "rating".

max_results.description: Maximum results to return. Defaults to 20.

name: unsave_business
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Remove a business from saved/bookmarked list.

name: update_review
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Update one of your own reviews. Only the current user's reviews can be modified.

rating.description: New star rating (1–5). None keeps current.

text.description: New review text. None keeps current.

photos.description: New photo list. None keeps current.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: The updated review object.

name: compose_review
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Write a review for a business. Each user can only post one review per business. Use update_review() to modify an existing review.

photos.description: Photo URLs or filenames to attach.
